mapper.select: SELECT dept.dept_id FROM sys_dept dept WHERE dept.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND dept.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND dept.dept_id NOT IN ( SELECT odr.dept_id FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t odr where odr.device_type = 4 AND odr.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} )

SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, t.province_id AS provinceId, t.city_id AS cityId, t.county_id AS countyId, t.town_code as townCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t d LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t t ON d.device_code = t.device_code WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.delete_flag = '0' AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} GROUP BY d.dept_id, t.province_id, t.city_id, t.county_id, t.town_code UNION SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, it.province_id AS provinceId, it.city_id AS cityId, it.county_id AS countyId, it.town_code as townCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t d LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t it ON d.device_code = it.device_code WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND it.delete_flag = '0' AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} GROUP BY d.dept_id, it.province_id, it.city_id, it.county_id, it.town_code UNION SELECT d.dept_id AS deptId, d.province_code AS provinceId, d.city_code AS cityId, d.county_code AS countyId, d.street_code as townCode FROM vm_organ_street_rel_t d WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND d.delete_flag = '0' AND d.category_code = 9 AND d.industry_code = #{industryCode} GROUP BY d.dept_id, d.province_code, d.city_code, d.county_code, d.street_code
select DEPT_ID as deptId, PROVINCE_CODE as provinceId, CITY_CODE as cityId, COUNTY_CODE as countyId FROM sys_dept_street_rel where DEPT_ID like concat(#{tenantId},'-%')
